idle:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production keyframe atlas for the existing Saber desktop companion.
Reference image 1 is the original character design and six action concepts. Reference image 2 is the already installed character's identity; keep exactly this face, costume and chibi proportions.
Draw the SAME Saber/Artoria knight: golden blonde bob, braided bun, curved ahoge, emerald green eyes, large royal blue hair bow, royal blue and white dress with gold trim, silver gauntlets and breastplate, tiny boots, Excalibur when the action calls for it. High quality cute polished anime illustration with crisp dark-blue outlines, soft luminous highlights.
OUTPUT ONE SQUARE transparent PNG. Exactly FOUR distinct full-body animation keyframes in a perfectly aligned invisible 2 COLUMN x 2 ROW equal grid, ordered top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right. Every quadrant has one COMPLETE standalone character with her associated prop/effect. Same camera angle, same character scale and head size in all four quadrants. Character face and costume must remain consistent. Every drawing including ahoge, sword tip, hands, props, magic effects must fit inside the CENTRAL 76% of its cell with wide genuinely transparent gutters. Generous top/bottom and side padding. Nothing crosses cell boundaries. Full figure even when seated. No panel borders, no lettering, no captions, no numbers, no speech bubbles, no watermark, no background gradients, no floor, no shadow, no checkerboard. Actual transparent alpha, no opaque backdrop.
Motion should change arms, face, props or clothing meaningfully between all four frames, not merely move or rotate an identical still image. Avoid huge cinematic effects that obscure the character. Use the character design's clear blue-gold-white palette.
Action: Tea break / original panel 04. She sits neatly, dress spread, tiny cup with gold crown motif and a navy saucer. Sword laid safely beside her. Keyframe 1: green eyes gently open, holding teacup at chest. Frame 2: lifting cup toward lips, eyes half closed. Frame 3: takes a small sip, eyes closed and happy, a fine curl of steam. Frame 4: lowers cup, content smile, a tiny musical note near her head. Keep seated hips/feet and cup consistent. No books stack or cat because readability at small size matters.
